QuestInfo.name: [Magatia] Searching for the Master Key
QuestInfo.1: I told #p2111006# that his pass was useless. Since it's such an old pass, its verification code might have expired. Figures. Anyway, #p2111006# says he'll do everything in his power to get me into the Secret Passage, and asked me to find #b10 #t4000363# items#k from #r#o6110301##k.\n\n#i4000363# #t4000363# #b#c4000363##k/10
QuestInfo.2: You fell for #p2111006#'s promise, and got 10 #t4000363#s from #o6110301# monsters. That's when #p2111006# started making new combinations of verification codes out of the #t4000363#s.

0.0: Sigh... I suppose the pass is so old that it did not get verified with their new security system. That's unfortunate... time flew by so fast that now I can't get verified... but that doesn't mean you can't get in. I, #p2111006#, will pull out all tricks in order for you to gain access to the secret passage, okay?

yes.0: What I want you to do now is get #b10 #t4000363#k from #r#o6110301##k. If we can make combinations out of those verification numbers, we may be able to figure out the master code, and that will get us into the Secret Passage.

no.0: Are... are you telling me you don't believe me? #p2111006#, the man of integrity and trust? Terrible!

1.0: You managed to get all 10 of the #t4000363#s. That's brilliant! Now let's make a combination of these verification numbers to come up with the master code...

yes.0: This requires a great amount of concentration, so please leave me alone for a while.
